**Launch & Communications Playbook – 2026  
Asian‑D2C Cosmetic Brand entering Mexico, Colombia, & Brazil**

---

## 1. Executive Snapshot  

| Country | Beauty Culture | Shade‑Range (base + extras) | Primary Marketplaces | Social‑Commerce Hot‑Spot |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------|---------------------|--------------------------|
| **Mexico** | “Fresh‑face, flawless” → lighter neutrals dominate; strong emphasis on sun‑protected skincare. | 14 neutral‑tint shades (12 neutrals + 2 deep tints) + 3 specialty “sun‑pro” tints. | Mercado Libre, Amazon MX, Walmart.com.mx (warehouse‑shipped). | Instagram Shopping + WhatsApp Business + TikTok (emerging). |
| **Colombia** | High‑contrast, bold color aesthetics; popularity of “lip‑only” looks. | 9 deep‑rich shades + 4 bright “accent” shades + 1 “self‑tint” foundation. | Mercado Libre + Linio + Falabella Colombia. | TikTok + Instagram Shopping + WhatsApp. |
| **Brazil** | Ultra‑inclusive palette, deep‑dark tones + vibrant accents; “self‑beauty” culture. | 16 full‑coverage dark shades + 6 accent bright shades + 4 “festive” limited‑sets. | Mercado Livre + Magazine Luiza + Submarino (B2C portal). | Instagram Shopping + Facebook Marketplace + WhatsApp. |

### Key Take‑Away
- **Shade strategy**: Each market receives a tailored base set that covers 70 % of local skin‑tones, plus an “exclusive” set to drive share‑of‑wallet & social‑commerce buzz.
- **Channel mix**: Owned D2C for margin, marketplaces for reach, and legacy MLM networks for trust.
- **Regulatory choke‑point**: All three countries have strict cosmetic labeling and packaging requirements; a single, auditable “Compliance Engine” will gate every SKU.

---

## 2. Strategic Objectives & Success Metrics  

| Objective | KPI | Target | Rationale |
|-----------|-----|--------|-----------|
| **Localized Brand Positioning** | Brand lift (t‑score) > +15 within 6 months | Increase market share >2 % | Gain credibility against entrenched MLM brands |
| **Cost‑Effective Acquisition** | CAC < $6 MX, < $9 CO, < $11 BR | Optimize marketing spend | Ensure profitable scale |
| **Sustainable Social Commerce** | 30‑day retention > 60 %; UGC posts > 2 k/quarter | Convert first‑time buyers into community | Leverage influencer ecosystem |
| **Compliance & Trust** | 0 regulatory incidents; NPS ≥ 70 | Avoid fines, build brand trust | Legacy MLM markets are highly risk‑averse |
| **Sales Channel Agility** | Marketplace share < 30 % of D2C revenue | Maximize margin while maintaining reach | Owned D2C offers higher ROAS |

---

## 3. Product & Shade Localization  

| Attribute | Mexico | Colombia | Brazil |
|-----------|--------|----------|--------|
| **Shade Base** | 12 neutral‑tint shades + 2 deep tints | 8 deep + 3 accent + 1 “self‑tint” | 16 dark shades + 6 bright accents |
| **Limited‑Edition Sets** | 1 “Summer Glow” (4 bright accents) | 1 “Fierce Lip Color” (3 high‑impact lipsticks) | 2 “Feira‑de‑Samba” packs (4 festive colors each) |
| **Packaging** | 30 ml tube, recyclable, Spanish QR | 30 ml tube, recyclable, Spanish QR | 50 ml tube, recyclable, Portuguese QR |
| **Ingredient Transparency** | 80 % natural claims (gluten‑free, no parabens) | 85 % natural + UV‑protection | 90 % natural + vegan, Cruelty‑Free |
| **AR Try‑On** | Embedded QR → app filter “Shade‑Match” + dermatologist advice | Same QR → “Try‑it‑now” filter + “Color‑pair” tool | Same QR → “Festive Look” filter + “Mix & Match” UI |
| **Packaging Compliance** | ISO 14644 compliant labelling; mandatory sunscreen index | EU Cosmetic Regulation adaptation (COF) | Brazilian Anvisa standard for cosmetic labelling |

---

## 4. Pricing, Payment & Local Currency Strategy  

| Market | Base Price (local currency) | Currency‑hedging | Payment Methods |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------|-----------------|
| **Mexico** | MXN $350 (≈$17) | Daily forward contract (5 % margin shift) | PayPal, OXXO (cash), Apple Pay |
| **Colombia** | COP $1 200 000 (≈$317) | Cross‑border SWIFT hedges | Mercado Pago, EPM, Apple Pay |

- **Dynamic Pricing Engine** (OPA + Python) will automatically shift 1‑3 % to absorb currency swings while keeping margin > 25 %.  
- **Local Promo Codes** (e.g., “MEXTAROT”, “COLCOLORS”, “BRGLOOM”) will funnel traffic from influencer DM and WhatsApp ads.

| **Social Commerce** | Instagram Shopping API, TikTok Shop SDK, WhatsApp Catalog | Click‑to‑buy flows; 24/7 chatbot | Social Commerce Lead |
| **Legacy MLM Network** | Refersion + custom payment gateway | “Invite‑Earn‑Earn” flow; 5‑tier commissions | Network Ops |
| **Analytics Hub** | Snowflake data lake + Looker Studio dashboards | Unified attribution & cohort segmentation | Data Analytics |

All touch‑points funnel into a single data lake, enabling cross‑channel attribution, real‑time KPI alerts, and a single source of truth for audit.

| 6 | Seasonal Push | ‘Summer Glow’ or ‘Festival’ bundle, email campaign | Sales uplift 15 % YoY |
| 9 | Mid‑Year Review | Influencer panel Q&A, US data, KPI review | 30‑day retention > 60 % |
| 12 | Holiday Campaign | ‘Beauty‑Bundle’ contest, influencer tie‑in | 20 % holiday sales lift |

---

## 10. Measurement Dashboard & Reporting  

All KPIs stored in **Snowflake → Looker Studio** dashboards. Key views:

| View | Data Sources | Frequency |
|------|--------------|-----------|
| **Acquisition** | Paid‑media spend, CPM, CAC | Daily |
| **Sales** | D2C, Marketplace, MLM | Weekly |
| **Engagement** | UGC volume, social reach, AR filter usage | Weekly |
| **Compliance** | Exported audit logs, regulatory alerts | Continuous |
| **Channel Mix** | Revenue % by channel | Monthly |
| **Net Promoter Score** | Survey integration | Quarterly |

**Executive Report** (PDF+interactive) delivered monthly to C‑suite; includes audit trail for every transaction.

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Triggering Event |
|------|------------|--------|------------|------------------|

| **Supply‑Chain Disruption** | Low | Medium | Dual‑source suppliers, safety‑stock 15 % | Supplier outage > 7 days |
| **Currency Shock** | Medium | Medium | Daily hedging, dynamic price engine | 5 % daily FX swing |
| **MLM Abuse** | Low | High | SLA, real‑time transaction monitoring, dispute protocol | 2 complaints/month |
| **Influencer PR Crisis** | Low | High | Crisis playbook, defamation clause, quick‑response team | 48 hr media spike |
| **Platform Policy Change** | Low | Medium | API backup, alternative channel | Marketplace policy change |

All incidents are logged into the **Compliance Engine** (OPA) and trigger an incident ticket within 24 h.

---

## 12. Governance & Compliance

| Local Compliance Hub (Mexico, Colombia, Brazil) | Translate regulation to local config | Legal‑to‑dev tickets, OPA policy store |
| Audit & Transparency Portal | Immutable log of packaging, ingredients, prices | ISO 27001‑certified storage, audit trail per SKU |
| Data Privacy Council | GDPR, LGPD, local privacy laws | Data residency mapping, audit reports, DPO sign‑off |

---

**Bottom Line**

This playbook marries a **globally consistent brand** with **deep local relevance** through tailored shade ranges, compliant packaging, and culturally resonant messaging. It leverages **multi‑channel depth** – high‑margin D2C, expansive marketplace reach, and legacy MLM trust – while keeping an **audit‑ready, data‑centric governance** that safeguards against regulatory, financial, and brand‑integrity risks. With the outlined milestones, budgets, and KPI framework, the brand can expect strong first‑month traction, sustainable adoption, and a scalable, compliant footprint across Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil.

---

### 1. Strategic Vision  
**Deliver a single, universally playable core while packaging monetization in a jurisdiction‑aware, audit‑ready shell.**  
- *Core*: uniform engine, storyline, character roster, matchmaking, cosmetic catalogue, and physics.  
- *Wrapper*: region‑specific UI overlays, pricing, reward logic, and compliance checks that can be toggled without touching game assets.  

---

### 2. Core Game Architecture (Zero Fragmentation)

| Layer | Design | Operational Impact |
|-------|--------|--------------------|
| Engine | Unity/Unreal 5.x, global build pipeline | One deployment per platform |
| Content | Shared assets, story, skins, and animation set | No duplicate art or levels |
| Server | Global data lake → multi‑region read replicas; state is region‑agnostic | Latency < 150 ms; real‑time sync |
| Matchmaking | Global shard; region‑specific latency caps | Cross‑border play possible |
| Analytics | Single event stream to Snowflake, schema‑agnostic | Unified dashboards |

### 3. Monetization Wrapper – Regulatory‑Safe Fabric

#### 3.1 Currency & Pricing
| Market Tier | Base Unit (Local) | VIP Bundle | Adjustment Logic |
|------------|------------------|-------------|------------------|
| Tier‑A (High inflation / low PPP) | 3 € | + % = +20 % | Index = CPI × (1 + inflation × 0.5) |
| Tier‑B | 2 $ | + % = +15 % | Same formula with local CPI |

| Jurisdiction | Rule | Implementation |
|--------------|------|----------------|
| Belgium/Netherlands | Loot‑box ban | *Fixed‑content reward packs* (exact set of items, no hidden probabilities). UI overlay hides “randomness”. |

| Gulf | Cultural sensitivity | “Present” packs (known content); local payment methods (Apple Pay, Mada); VAT‑adjusted prices. |
| Brazil | Limited‑edition cosmetics | Non‑random limited‑sets; expiry dates displayed. |
| US | Pay‑to‑win popularity | Two channels: *Cosmetic loot‑boxes* (fully disclosed) & *Boost tier* (utility only). Boosts are strictly utility‑only and capped. |

#### 3.3 Combat‑Fairness Controls
| Item | Labeling | Cap | Auditable |
|------|----------|-----|-----------|
| Boosts | “Utility‑Only” badge | Max × 2 % of match score | Yes (log replay) |
| Random Rewards | “Random” badge, odds table | None for cosmetic items | Yes (daily audit) |

| Brazil | Limited‑edition cosmetics | Non‑random bundles | Storefront filter + expiry clock |
| US | Pay‑to‑win culture | Separate tab: Cosmetic box, Boost tier | Config flag in UI router |

| Body | Responsibility | Tools / Process |

| Player‑Advocacy Consortium | Gather cross‑border sentiment; flag risk | Monthly calls, sentiment‑analysis dashboards |
| Transparency Dashboard | Role‑based view of odds, sales, compliance status | Azure AD + SharePoint + Power BI |
| Audit Trail | Immutable log of every purchase with time, region, config, odds | ISO 27001‑certified storage, quarterly forensic review |

| Risk | Mitigation | KPI |

| Algorithmic bias | Weekly odds audit, sanity checks | Odds variance ≤ 5 % |

By keeping the **core game identical** and separating **regulatory‑safe monetize wrappers**, we protect the brand, satisfy diverse market regulations, and maintain a unified global community.
